title: crumbkit/weigh/v1
description: The bytes that an agent reads on each path through a tool's help.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

Weight.description: What one visible command of a tool costs an agent to read, in bytes.

help_before.description: With --usage, the help pages that each run's session read since its previous run that printed no help page, summed over the command's runs, and null without it.

long_help.description: The bytes of the command's `--help` page.

output.description: The bytes of the largest golden file of the command's examples, or null when no example has a golden file.

p95_output.description: With --usage, the 95th percentile of the bytes that the command's runs wrote to standard output, and null without it or when no run printed a result.

path.description: The command line that runs the command, such as `shelf books list`.

path_total.description: The bytes that an agent reads to find and run the command: each `-h` page from the root down to the command, and the command's output.

runs.description: With --usage, the runs of the command in the usage log that printed no help page, and null without it.

short_help.description: The bytes of the command's `-h` page.
